sources.title: Ling-3.0-tiny-GGUF: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Ling-3.-tiny-GGUF is a GGUF quantization of the original Ling-3.0-tiny model from inclusionAI, converted directly from BF16 safetensors and maintained by bloomer010. The model contains 7.9 billion total parameters with 1.3 billion active parameters per token, using a hybrid architecture of 18 KDA (Key-Dependent Attention) layers and 6 MLA (Multi-Head Latent Attention) layers across ...
